# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START

    return -float(node.id)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def neighbor_latency(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, graph: CallGraphCtx, state: ClusterState) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    m = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = graph.src[e]
        d = graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod.id:
            other = d
        if d == pod.id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = state.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                total += graph.rate[e] * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    return total

def dest_fits(state: ClusterState, k: int, pod: Pod, moved_pods: list[int], moved_dests: list[int]) -> int:
    dest = state.nodes[k]
    if dest.suspended:
        return 0
    cpu_use = dest.cpu_allocated
    mem_use = dest.mem_allocated
    for mi in range(len(moved_dests)):
        if moved_dests[mi] == k:
            mpod = state.pods[moved_pods[mi]]
            cpu_use += mpod.cpu_request
            mem_use += mpod.mem_request
    cpu_after = cpu_use + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = mem_use + pod.mem_request
    if cpu_after > dest.cpu_capacity:
        return 0
    if mem_after > dest.mem_capacity:
        return 0
    return 1

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000000.0
    total_lat = 0.0
    m = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = ctx.graph.src[e]
        d = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod.id:
            other = d
        if d == pod.id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                total_lat += ctx.graph.rate[e] * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    cpu_ratio = 0.0
    if node.cpu_capacity > 0:
        cpu_ratio = float(cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_ratio = 0.0
    if node.mem_capacity > 0:
        mem_ratio = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    util = cpu_ratio
    if mem_ratio > util:
        util = mem_ratio
    power_after = node.power_idle_w + (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * util
    cpu_cur = 0.0
    if node.cpu_capacity > 0:
        cpu_cur = float(node.cpu_allocated) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_cur = 0.0
    if node.mem_capacity > 0:
        mem_cur = float(node.mem_allocated) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    util_cur = cpu_cur
    if mem_cur > util_cur:
        util_cur = mem_cur
    power_cur = node.power_idle_w + (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * util_cur
    marginal = power_after - power_cur
    wake_penalty = 0.0
    if node.cpu_allocated <= 0 and node.mem_allocated <= 0:
        wake_penalty = 800.0
        if node.suspendable:
            wake_penalty += 400.0
    pack_bonus = 0.0
    if node.cpu_allocated > 0 or node.mem_allocated > 0:
        pack_bonus = 600.0
    return pack_bonus - marginal - 0.8 * total_lat - wake_penalty

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    n = len(state.nodes)
    p = len(state.pods)
    moved_pods: list[int] = []
    moved_dests: list[int] = []
    moved = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        src = state.nodes[i]
        src_cpu_ratio = 0.0
        if src.cpu_capacity > 0:
            src_cpu_ratio = float(src.cpu_allocated) / float(src.cpu_capacity)
        src_mem_ratio = 0.0
        if src.mem_capacity > 0:
            src_mem_ratio = float(src.mem_allocated) / float(src.mem_capacity)
        src_util = src_cpu_ratio
        if src_mem_ratio > src_util:
            src_util = src_mem_ratio
        drainable = (not src.suspended) and src_util < 0.5
        if drainable:
            for j in range(p):
                if moved >= budget:
                    return out
                pod = state.pods[j]
                eligible = pod.current_node == i and not pod.stateful and not pod.has_pdb
                if eligible:
                    best = -1
                    best_score = -1000000000.0
                    for k in range(n):
                        fit_flag = dest_fits(state, k, pod, moved_pods, moved_dests)
                        ok = k != i and fit_flag == 1
                        if ok:
                            dest = state.nodes[k]
                            s = 0.0
                            if dest.cpu_allocated > 0 or dest.mem_allocated > 0:
                                s += 600.0
                            if not dest.suspendable:
                                s += 150.0
                            lat = neighbor_latency(pod, dest, graph, state)
                            s -= lat * 0.6
                            s -= dest.power_idle_w * 0.1
                            if s > best_score:
                                best_score = s
                                best = k
                    if best >= 0:
                        out.append(move_pod(pod.id, best))
                        moved_pods.append(j)
                        moved_dests.append(best)
                        moved += 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
